title: Hankel Transform and $(α,β)$ Somos-4 Sequences
summary: An $(α,β)$ Somos-$4$ sequence $S_n$ is defined by the recurrence $S_nS_{n-4}=αS_{n-1}S_{n-3}+βS_{n-2}^2$ ($n\geq 4$), with suitable initial values, where $α$ and $β$ are constant parameters. A widely studied question is the following: When does the Hankel transform of a generating function become an $(α,β)$ Somos-4 sequence? In particular, how can $α$ and $β$ be derived for such a function? A sufficient condition for this problem has been established by Wang and Zhang.
